title: TRANSPORT PHENOMENA I
description: Applies momentum and energy transfer phenomena to fluid (i.e., gases and liquids) flow for the design of processes in chemical, biological, and environmental engineering.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 256 or 256H) and (CBEE 212*, 212H* or 280*).
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 256, MTH 256H, CBEE 212, CBEE 212H and CBEE 280.
